examples.arabic: "هيك راح نغير جو، ونشوف البحر، ونجرب مناقيش الجبنة."
examples.english: "This way we will change atmosphere, and see the sea, and try cheese manakish."
examples.transliteration: Heik rah nghayyir jaww, w nshouf el-bahr, w njareb manaqeesh el-jibneh.

examples.arabic: أكلت مناقيش الجبنة وكانت كتير منيح.
examples.english: She ate cheese manakish and it was very good.
examples.transliteration: Akalat manaqeesh el-jibneh w kaanat kteer mniih.
examples.storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

examples.arabic: شربت شاي النعنع السخن، وأكلت مناقيش الجبنة الشهية.
examples.english: She drank the hot mint tea, and ate delicious cheese manakish.
examples.transliteration: Sherbet shay el-na'na' as-sokhon, w akalet manaqeesh el-jibneh ash-shahiyyeh.

examples.arabic: كنت ماشي بالسوق وشميت ريحة مناقيش الجبنة
examples.english: I was walking in the market and smelled the cheese manakish.
examples.transliteration: Kunt mashi bil-souq w shammeet reehet manaqeesh el-jibneh.

examples.arabic: انا جوعان وبدي مناقيش جبنه زاكيه للحفلة
examples.english: I am hungry and I want delicious cheese manakish for the party.
examples.transliteration: Ana jawaan w biddi manaqeesh jibneh zakyeh lil-hafle.

examples.arabic: ممكن ناكل مناقيش جبنه زاكيه على الفطور هناك
examples.english: Maybe we can eat delicious cheese manakish for breakfast there.
examples.transliteration: Mumken nakol manaqeesh jibneh zakyeh alal-ftoor hnak.
